summary: All five issues checked against the code and fixed in next/box/skills/dyna-services/SKILL.md. (1) Undo after set: store/services.go deletes the secrets a new declaration drops, so the undo line now says to set again the value of any dropped secret after restoring the file, and to make sure the value's holder can set it again before dropping one. The Secrets section now says a replaced value is undone only by setting the previous value again. (2) data: contract/service.go:161 refuses space : , " % \ $ = (and control characters), so the data row now lists those characters. (3) Stop intent: lifecycle/services.go sets WantRun only in StartService, and the store's set UPDATE leaves want alone. The stop/start bullet now says stop is done at state stopped, that set, update and rollback keep a stopped service stopped, and to run start before waiting for the running check. (4) room log: the line now names the room log tool with types service.changed and service.failed. (5) The image save / FROM ${DYNA_BASE} sentences are replaced with 'Prefer a small registry image pinned by digest; for a room image, see dyna-images.' The later image save then update order is kept. No issue rejected. CLI built; service set/update/rollback/stop/start/restart/logs/show/secret set --help checked. go test ./box/skills passes. Committed as arismoko.
